current.title: Movie Night Art Prompt
current.text: Turn down the lights and grab your popcorn cause it's movie night in Caramella!! Draw your candyfloss enjoying a film in the movies, recording their own home movie or acting the part by cosplaying their favorite movie or TV characters! It's time for a night at the cinema in the Movie Night Art Prompt!
current.blurb: Turn down the lights and grab your popcorn cause it's movie night in Caramella!!

current.title: Luau Art Prompt
current.text: Let the music move you in this summer time prompt! Those long summer days are coming to an end and the Candyfloss want to invite you to party the season away at a Luau! Draw your candyfloss enjoying the sights, sounds and dance moves in a lambdan luau!
current.blurb: Draw your candyfloss enjoying the sights, sounds and dance moves in a lambdan luau!

past.title: Spring Cleaning Art Prompt
past.text: Spring is here! The Candyfloss are celebrating the start of a new season by cleaning their homes, ridding themselves of the junk they've accumulated and washing clean their chakras with some good old fashion scrubbing bubbles! Draw your Candyfloss getting clean or cleaning their space for this prompt! Whether it's hoovering up a storm, or frothing up some bubbles in the bath, the Candyfloss are getting clean in the Spring Cleaning Prompt!

past.title: House Plants Art Prompt
past.text:
Let it grow! Candyfloss with green thumbs unite in this prompt! Floss of all sorts adore gardening!
Whether they are the type to burn through potted plants faster than a Kappafloss can sprint, or if they are a respectable plant-mom and have a house filled with greenery, we want to see their beloved potted plants!
Enter the House plants Art Prompt

past.title: Dog Days Chain Game
past.text:
From Paizo pups, to Anijuru, to Rushounds and more! The Candyfloss just adore their loyal companions!
We are giving some love to our Dog type petpets this month with the Dog Days chain game! Join the chain to draw the above floss with their furry companion! Come jump into the Chain game to give some pats and paws and see those tails wag!
Join the Dog Days Chain game!

past.title: First Day of School Story Prompt
past.text:
School is in session! So many exciting things can happen when a young floss sets out to their first day of school!
Whether it's the exciting new world of kindergarten, the drama filled high school days, or the party-filled adventure of college, anything can happen when a floss steps into a new life in a new school! Write a short story about your candyfloss' first day at a new school! What wacky shinnanigans or prospective love stories await them? Maybe they're joining a super hero school to learn to use their powers for good, or maybe they're joining a sensei to learn the ways of the Thetan Shinobi or the Epsilonion monks! We want to hear all about their chaotic first day!
Enter the First Day of School Short Story Prompt!

past.title: Breakfast Time Art Prompt
past.text: Bacon! Eggs! Toast! Oh, my! It's breakfast time on Caramella! Draw your Candyfloss enjoying breakfast for this prompt! Whether it's a hearty 3 course breakfast spread, a protein packed energy shake, or scraps from a Knan'Nibble infested dumpster, show us how your Candyfloss eats for their first meal of the day!!

past.title: Lakeside Story Prompt
past.text: Grab your flip flops and floaties, cause we're going to the lake! Candyfloss are beating the heat this summer with lakeside cookouts. Write a story about your Candyfloss going to the lake for this literature prompt! What shenanigans do they get up to by the water!? Is it a fun romp with friends? A romantic randezvous by the lakeside, or is there something sinister lurking in the depths?

past.title: Pool Floaties Chain Game
past.text: Splash into our summer time chain game! Dive in to the chain and draw the Candyfloss before you beating the heat and catching some rays in the pool. Whether they are blasting water guns or lounging on a giant flamingo floatie, the choice is yours! Just depict a Floss floating their worries away, and the next artist will draw yours! Pass the torch, give a gift, and get in on the sunny poolside fun!
past.blurb: Splash into our summer time chain game!

past.title: Love Arrow Story Prompt
past.text: Cupidfloss are in the air looking to give some unsuspecting Floss a love bug! But their aim isn't always straight. What happens when a rogue love arrow strikes your Candyfloss right in the heart!? Will this sudden accident lead to absolute chaos, or is it the start of a beautiful romance? Write a story from the perspective of a cupidfloss (can be one of your floss or an npc) or from the perspective of the sudden lovers!
past.blurb: Cupidfloss are in the air looking to give some unsuspecting Floss a love bug!

future.title: Dress Up Dollie
future.text: Find your inner fashion designer in this glamorize dress to enter Candyfloss Raffle event!

future.title: Cozy up! Outfit design chain
future.text: Autumn has arrived in caramella! All of the Candyfloss are bundling up in their Autumnal bests in preparation for Sweater weather! Design a cozy fit for the floss at the end of the chain, and throw your floss up to receive a custom outfit from the next artist in the chain!

future.title: Luck of the Draw! Art prompt
future.text: Dice! Cards! Casinos! The Iotafloss love to Gamble, and have invited you to test your luck! Draw your Candyfloss in an art peice themed around casinos, Card games, Poker chips, Slot machines, dice, etc. for this Iota inspired Art prompt!

current.title: Floss of the Month: Haniko
current.text:
Meet Haniko! Haniko is what some would call a real ‘busy bee’ and always on the move! She loves to work hard, and known to many for her ability to get any job done! She was a Honeyfloss, until she picked up a mysterious shard. Wanting to protect others, unknowingly she took it, quickly realizing her mistake as he became a hybrid. With this change, she decided to reinvent her life and take it by the horns. Nothing was going to stop Haniko in her ambitions, from her fun hobbies of beekeeping to her more lucrative hobbies of podcasting. She loves being recognized for her work, and giving back to her community as well.

Haniko belongs to g0thieg0re! G0thieg0re joined our community last year, and has made her mark by showing their love of creating lore and joining in the conversation! She likes creates funhorror themed floss and share her lovely art with the community. She always has something funny and kind to say to others art as well, sharing a unique fun and kindness wherever she goes.
current.blurb: Meet Haniko! Haniko is what some would call a real ‘busy bee’ and always on the move! Haniko belongs to g0thieg0re!

past.title: Floss of the Month: Nyree
past.text:
Nyree is a young adult born to an Iotan father and his Lambdan sweetheart, raised in the comfort of luxury in Iota. Her father came from generational wealth as well as his father’s ties to mafioso, which comes back to haunt him. She met her best friend, a Theta girl named Posey, when she was a youth, and despite being raised as a typical Betan, she became Posey’s number one defender against Thetan and trufflephobes. When Nyree turned 15 eyo, she lost her father in a car accident and she became closed off for a while, in the meantime her mother decided to move from clan to clan for work, where she met many different floss of different clans and became friends. She even met a girl named Isobel and started dating her long distance until she bought a cottage in Delta and moved in with her. There, Nyree created a beautiful garden, using her passion to create a living by beekeeping and painting. Her relationship with Isobel fell apart after a year and a half eyo and she moved back to Beta and lived with her best friend Posey. She met a Betafloss named Junko and the two hit it off and are now dating. Nyree’s mother gave birth to her half-sister during her time back in Beta, thrilling her as she always wanted to be a big sister. A year later, war broke out in Theta, changing Nyree’s best friend irreparably and changing her views on her homeland of Beta forever. She moved to Lambda alongside her mother and baby sister, where she now has another blossoming garden, resuming her life as a botanist and artist as best she can after all the uncertainty of the world around her.
Nyree belongs to the ever so lovely FadedFaeble! Faeble has been a longtime member of the candyfloss community, often seen in the discord and participating in our events. Faeble is a wonderful designer and artist, you’ve probably seen one of their petpets! She’s friendly and always excited to see what our other members are doing. Thank you for being part of the Candyfloss community, Faeble!

past.title: Floss of the Month: Chase
past.text:
Meet Chase! Chase is a Thetan Peppermintfloss who loves the night life! Parties, bright lights, and huge crowds are Chase's happy place! He's a party animal that can't be stopped! He's a rambunctious and energetic demiboy who just wants to have a good time and let loose!! He is a pop idol from the land of Phi and thrives on party culture and fame! Chase comes from a poor background, and has worked hard to become the star he is today! He is known to use his invisibility in his concerts to make it appear as if he pops in and out of different locations while he sings.

Chase belongs to the user Ghosting30s! Ghosting is a long standing member of the Candyfloss Community and is always bringing smiles and good vibes wherever it goes! It is always around to support others and joke around, bringing smiles to everyone's faces! Thank you for being a part of our community, Ghosting!

past.title: Floss of the Month: Medha
past.text:
This month's FOTM is Medha! She's a Sourfloss student living in the Epsilon region. She's a bright and social floss who cares a lot about philosophy and ethics. Never fully identifying with the technology centric culture of the Sigma region, she moved to the Epsilon region to be more in touch with her epsilon telepathic abilities. She's currently living in with Rosemary, a sweet old Honeyfloss librarian that was her mother's college professor back in the day!

Medha belongs to JubLubDubs! JubLubs is a recent member of the Candyfloss community, but she's already been a delight to be around! She has a very fun and unique art style that's always nice to see in the art channels! We're glad you've been enjoying Candyfloss, both in lore and the community! Thank you for being a part of Candyfloss, JubLub!

future.title: Floss of the Month: Crystal
future.text:
Meet Crystal!

Crystal is a sweet floss who might be found daydreaming, reading a book, making something, or even participating in an Omadaball tournament. The sky's the limit with this optimistic floss!

Crystal belongs to Crystalbinja! Crystal is a longtime member of our community. From participating to events, organizing community projects, collecting an impressive amount of hybridfloss, and drawing adorable art, Crystal does it all. In particular, she's a wizard with spreadsheets. She's a gem in our community and we're happy to have them. Say "hi" to them if you see her!
